name: Fujimiya Wakaba
source:
Gifted with the ability to prophesize the future, she can also heal. Her ardent desire is to improve her abilities so that she can heal her sister’s heart condition. She has a shy and compassionate personality. [spoiler]She has weak clairvoyance ability.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wind:_A_Breath_of_Heart]Wikipedia[/url]]

[spoiler]Is the real sister of [url=/c472]Hinata[/url] and [url=/c13710]Minamo[/url].[/spoiler]
